about_the_game:
After a devastating breakup, Wyatt Lacey finds himself consumed by grief and self-loathing.
One night, drawn by forces he doesn’t understand. He finds a sword on a trail near his house, and ends up wandering into a decaying asylum hidden deep in the woods.

Inside its rusted halls, shadows take shape as monsters born from a mysterious force. and some friendly faces too, offering cryptic guidance, while some promise freedom through ruin.

Wyatt must confront his past, navigate the labyrinth of his own despair, and decide if he will fight for healing… or surrender to hell.

Psychological Horror in a Classic Style

Greatest Angels is a compact, story-driven horror JRPG built to capture the unsettling pacing of classic psychological horror games. Featuring sprite-based exploration and haunting character encounters, it blends retro presentation with a modern, narrative-heavy design.

Atmospheric Sound and Visuals

While the asylum itself shifts in ways that defy sense. Nothing feels stable, as if the world is quietly unraveling around you. it can be harsh to look at or hear, or it can be beauty in every form through sight and sound.

Surreal Environments

Explore an asylum where every area carries symbolic meaning tied to Wyatt’s trauma. An Abandoned Jail, Makeshift Ritual Sights, A Hospital, and The Gardens underneath...

Survival Horror Exploration & JRPG Combat

Face grotesque monsters like Knife-body, Sorrow Eyes, and the wanderers The Burdened and The Siphoners. Collect limited items, solve puzzles, and fight using a simple but tense JRPG combat system, where each battle feels like a test of endurance and fear.

Multiple Endings

Your choices throughout the game shape Wyatt’s fate. Will he fight his despair & lose himself completely? Or grasp at a fragile new hope?

content_descriptors.notes: Scenes in this game may depict mature topics such as suicide, mental illness, drug abuse.
